newsitem.title: USA: Wallace Computer holders vote more shares.
newsitem.headline: Wallace Computer holders vote more shares.

text.p: Wallace Computer Services Inc said Friday that shareholders at a special meeting approved an increase in the company's authorized common shares outstanding to 100 million from 50 million.
The additional shares will be available for stock splits, stock dividends, employee benefit plans, to raise funds and for acquisitions, Wallace said in a statement.
Shareholders also approved the company's 1997 stock incentive plan which will replace a 1989 stock option plan, the company said.
Wallace said the new plan is designed to align further the interests of certain employees, officers and directors with the company's stockholders.
Wallace makes and distributes information management products. Its shares were trading up 5/8 to 34.
